description: No time, budget, or resources are allocated for champions' personal growth in security.
Champions are expected to grow their skills on their own time, with no organizational investment.
Some training budget or time is occasionally made available to champions.
The organization consistently invests dedicated time and budget in champions' training, certifications, and growth opportunities.
Structured, ongoing investment (dedicated learning time, budget, career paths) ensures champions continuously grow, and this investment is protected even under organizational pressure.
